description: This Java class `SelectContactActivity` is an Android activity that displays a list of contacts for the user to select from, intended for sharing purposes within a direct share feature. It manages the display of contacts, handles user interactions, and returns the selected contact's ID via an intent.

classes.name: SelectContactActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that presents a list of contacts for the user to select and share with.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, checks intent action, and sets up the contacts list.
